name: Report of Employee Controlled Substance Incidents to Law Enforcement
description: Report of employee possession, use, or sale of controlled substances or paraphernalia on school property, at school activities, or on school transportation, per the MOU with law enforcement.
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall immediately report incidents involving the prohibited possession, use or sale of a controlled substance or drug paraphernalia as defined in the Pennsylvania Controlled Substance, Drug, Device and Cosmetic Act by any employee while on school property
